Learn Language multilingual dictionaries, edition 2.0.0 (editorial preview).

Korean Learners' Dictionary (한국어기초사전), National Institute of Korean Language (국립국어원): Korean headwords, definitions, translated equivalents/definitions and Korean sentence examples. Adaptations by Learn Language contributors: reorganising bilingual equivalents into study-language headwords, selecting senses, adding editorial levels and topic tags, normalising forms and linking lexical facts. Adaptations are offered under CC BY-SA 4.0, using the later same-elements licence option in section 4(2) of the original Korean licence. Unmodified source text retains its original licence. Native-speaker review is pending; no official exam membership or dictionary-provider endorsement is claimed.

Text licence CC BY-SA 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . Each reused item retains the source article URL and contributor-history URL. Quotation-type examples, attributed quotations, images and audio are excluded. Source translations present in the extract are identified as source English translations, not newly reviewed translations. https://kaikki.org/dictionary/rawdata.html

National Institute of Korean Language, 2017 International Standard Curriculum for the Korean Language (vocabulary spreadsheet revised 2020): headword grade evidence, under Korea Open Government Licence Type 1 (attribution). https://www.korean.go.kr/front/reportData/reportDataView.do?mn_id=207&report_seq=932 . The original 1.0.0 starter definitions and bilingual examples remain CC BY 4.0, Learn Language contributors, 2026: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . They are preserved with their stable identifiers. App code remains MIT.

Store-distribution compliance and language review remain release checks, not completed certifications.

Complete bilingual example coverage has not been achieved. Untranslated native source examples are labelled separately and are excluded from sentence quizzes. No generic repeated topic sentence is counted as a completed usage example.

유럽의 중부에 있는 나라. 제이 차 세계 대전 후에 동서로 분단되었다가 1990년 통일되었다. 경제 대국이며 과학 기술과 공업이 매우 발전하였다. 공용어는 독일어이고 수도는 베를린이다.
